restaurantName: Marco Pierre White Steakhouse at Clifton Hotel
address: Clifton Gardens The Leas Folkestone Kent,CT20 2EB
bio: Afternoon Tea has found a new home in the renowned Marco Pierre White Steakhouse at The Clifton Hotel in Folkestone. Get together with friends for a quintessentially British tradition.  Enjoy treats such as carrot cake, macarons and sachertorte alongside delicate finger sandwiches and traditional scones. Why not enjoy Afternoon Tea with a glass of prosecco or Champagne?  Marco Pierre White Steakhouse is located inside the traditional Clifton Hotel that is seeped in Victorian History. You'll be able to take in the stunning sea views whilst sipping on a traditional English Afternoon Tea.
pageTitle: Marco Pierre White Steakhouse at Clifton Hotel
